blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: You should save some money against a rainy day.
exercises.ru: Вам следует откладывать сколько-то денег на ___.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last.» — DLI, Lesson 73.

exercises.q: I'll pick her up in an hour.
exercises.why: «Prepositions in time expressions»: в, на, по, с, до, за, к, через, назад. — DLI, Lessons 73–77.

exercises.q: "In one night," Dima added.
exercises.why: «The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.» — DLI, Lesson 77.

exercises.q: She gave birth to twins a week ago.

exercises.q: Я подстригаюсь ___ (каждый месяц).
exercises.prompt: I get a haircut every month.
exercises.why: «The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" … каждый день, каждое утро, каждую среду (acc.)»; «весь день, всё утро, всю неделю (accus.)». — DLI, Lessons 22, 37.

exercises.q: Спидометр сейчас показывает 100 миль в ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: The speedometer is recording 100 mph now.
exercises.why: «The preposition В + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day … (b) to indicate the day of the week … (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs.» — DLI, Lesson 73.
